plain_summary: This page continues the definitions of terms used in the Tariff Book, under the general heading 'Tariffs subject to VAT at 15%: Tariffs in South African Rand'. It defines terms such as 'Port Rules', 'Republic', 'Revenue Office', 'SAMSA', 'shift', 'small vessel', 'tanker', 'Tariff Book', 'Transhipment', and 'Transnet'. Crucially, it also defines 'Unit of tonnage' for tariffing purposes, specifying that 1 metric ton equals 1000 kg with a minimum of 1 ton, that bulk liquids are measured as 1 kilolitre, and that all packaging must be included in the metric tonnage calculation.

formulas.formula_as_written:
1 metric ton (1 000 kg), subject to a minimum of 1 ton, except for the following:
• Bulk liquids = 1 kilolitre
• The metric tonnage for tariffing purposes of cargo dues shall include all packaging i.e. mass of cargo, cases, pallets, bags etc.
formulas.what_it_calculates: The 'Unit of tonnage' for tariffing purposes of cargo dues.
formulas.rounding_or_conditions: Subject to a minimum of 1 ton. Shall include all packaging (mass of cargo, cases, pallets, bags etc.).

calculation_relevant_numbers.context: Unit of tonnage for bulk liquids
